ops.body: - Walk-screen UI review of modes-to-layers (Nov 19): the open Layers panel covers a third of the map where a toggled layer's result appears (U4), and "Storefronts" names both a route leaning in Walk settings and a map layer in the panel, so a choice made in one reads as lost in the other (U5). Both are older than the slice; a distinct route label ("Shopping streets") and a panel that stays out of the result's way would fix them, shown by screenshots.
